name: A level-12 Venomancer spends its class and Stalking points and cannot exceed them (#6639)
contract: #6639: a level-12 Venomancer could not save its talents ('localspec' errors). Classified already fixed on main: #5507 removed the .localspec bridge and the client talks to the server only through the native CMSG 0x0727 upload. CharacterAdvancementEssence gives class 29 2 class points (AE) and 1 specialization point (TE) at level 12. Choosing Stalking (ChrSpecs 53) uploads identity 4053 (92143) and its signature 7229 Hive Instinct (804968, 1 AE). Class entry 29607 Envenomed Weapons (300855, 1 AE) spends the second class point and Stalking entry 6078 (804975, 1 TE, TabTEInvestment 0) the specialization point; neither has a level gate or an unmet tab-investment gate. Stalking entry 7189 Venomous Bite (630900) itself needs TabTEInvestment 23 and is out of reach at this budget, so it is not used here. A further class entry 6082 (300664, 1 AE) and Stalking entry 7190 Contagion (503851, 1 TE, also TabTEInvestment 8) must both be refused by the exhausted budget without changing the build.

steps.label: Stalking grants its Hive Instinct signature
Spend the second class point on Envenomed Weapons
Spend the Stalking point on an ungated Stalking entry
A third class point is refused
The refused class talent is not learned
A second Stalking point is refused
The refused Stalking talent is not learned
The Stalking entry is still learned after the refusals
Envenomed Weapons is still learned after the refusals
